name: Spin Log
description: Track your bike's service history, documents, and insurance with ease.
_comment_background: background_color and theme_color are #fb6900 because that is the exact orange of the icon's own background, sampled from assets/icons/icon-512.png. They were #e35d01, a darker orange, so the splash screen showed the logo tile sitting on a visibly different field. The dark #050505 theme-color meta in index.html is deliberate and separate: it tints the status bar while the app is RUNNING, and the app is dark. This pair is only the splash.
